title: Kettle & Vane Coffee Roasters
body_text: Kettle & Vane is a small-batch coffee roaster and cafe in Asheville, North Carolina. We roast single-origin beans in-house daily, run a monthly subscription, and supply wholesale accounts across the region. Retail bags are $16 to $24; the subscription starts at $18 per month. Say hello at team@example-roasters.test. Our voice is warm, unfussy, and curious about where coffee comes from.
